## History

John Selwyn emigrated from the Old Country to work as a schoolteacher in the [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen), where he boarded with Captain Jim's father and became close friends with the young [Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md) despite being ten years older. He built a house in [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds) and planted rose bushes outside for his bride. Believing a gift or curse had been passed down to him from a great-great-grandmother who was burned as a witch, he shared his stories and life with those around him.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P5](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P10](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0010), [v4 CHAPTER 23 OWEN FORD COMES P12](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0012)_
